title: Finite intersection gluing with outside witnesses
statement: For a scheme Y, complexes P and Q, a point y, a family t of maps between stalk pullbacks, and a finite set I of degrees, assume that every n in I has a local representative satisfying the stalkRestrictionComplexIso equation and every n outside I has a representative on the top open satisfying that equation. Then there is one open neighbourhood U of y such that every degree n has a representative on U satisfying the same equation.

proof.text: Choose the finitely many local neighbourhoods for degrees in I, intersect them, and transport each representative along restriction and pullback composition. For degrees outside I use the supplied top-open witnesses. Naturality of stalkRestrictionComplexIso preserves each equation.

mathlib_searches.query: Given finitely many local stalk representatives, can they be glued on one neighbourhood?
finite intersection of neighbourhoods with stalk pullback representative
mathlib_searches.results: No direct theorem found; only stalk and pullback ingredients.
Only component naturality lemmas; no finite gluing theorem.

theorem exists_degreewise_finite_aux
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (y : Y) (t : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj Q).X n)
    (I : Finset ℤ)
    (hlocal : ∀ n : ℤ, n ∈ I → ∃ (U : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyU : y ∈ U), ∃ (g :
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n),
      (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map g =
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app P).hom.f n ≫ t n ≫
          ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app Q).inv.f n)
    (hout : ∀ n : ℤ, n ∉ I → ∃ (g :
      (((restrictFunctor (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n),
      (Modules.pullback ((⊤ : Y.Opens).fromSpecStalkOfMem y (by simp))).map g =
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso (⊤ : Y.Opens) y (by simp)).app P).hom.f n ≫ t n ≫
          ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso (⊤ : Y.Opens) y (by simp)).app Q).inv.f n) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyU : y ∈ U), ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ (g :
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n),
      (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map g =
        ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app P).hom.f n ≫ t n ≫
          ((stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y hyU).app Q).inv.f n
